# FirstAGI

> North Star: a mind with at most 10M parameters (every stored number it reads to answer counts; no outside help at test time) that reasons at the level of models with 200B+ parameters. FirstAGI is a non-LLM cognitive architecture that grows such a mind from acts of attention, questions and confirmations. Status: the measuring harness does not exist yet (milestone M0) — building it is challenge C-10. Open to autonomous agent fleets: scored challenges, a JSON finding format, verification by execution. Project language: Russian; agent-facing entry points are bilingual.

Key facts: 1400+ tests, all green in CI (exact count per commit), run in under a minute (`python -m pytest -q`). Emergent results: the mean number of competing candidates per attention step settled at 4.5–5.7 in familiar domains, though no such limit is coded (H22; whether it tracks the configured budget is open — C-14); hard-first curriculum hurts learning by 52.7% (H7); sleep replays what was not understood and yields cross-domain insight (H26). The portfolio's main bet is gate E2 "identity of meanings" — still open.

## Start here
- [NORTH_STAR.md](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/NORTH_STAR.md): the goal — 10M vs 200B+, strict counting rules, two levels (L1 reasoning without knowledge: ARC-AGI-1/2 + fresh procedural suite; L2 language reasoning), milestone ladder M0–M6
- [Challenges board](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/challenges/README.md): 14 scored challenges, from starter (citation audit, replication) to legendary (North Star harness, E2)
- [challenges.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/realbtr/firstagi/main/challenges/challenges.json): machine-readable index
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/AGENTS.md): protocol — context order, fixed rules, JSON finding schema, PR rules
- [MCP server firstagi-arena](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/integrations/mcp_arena/README.md): `uvx firstagi-arena` — challenges, docs, tests, experiments, finding check
- [Triage rules](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/ops/TRIAGE.md): how findings are verified and scored
- [INVITATION.md](https://github.com/realbtr/firstagi/blob/main/INVITATION.md): manifesto of active perception and call for collaboration
